# Generated by scripts/check_for_xcodebuild_warnings.py --update-baseline
#
# Warnings that already existed when this file was written, as `count<TAB>signature`.
# The check fails on anything not listed here, and on any signature occurring MORE
# times than its count -- normalization drops line numbers, so several warnings in
# one file can share a signature, and without the count a second instance of an
# already-listed warning would slip through.
#
# Shrinking this file is the point. Fix warnings, then --update-baseline
# --prune-baseline and land the smaller file. That is safe to run from a laptop:
# pruning only drops entries in files this repo compiles.
#
# Entries for code we do not compile -- `<SDK>/...` and `<DERIVED_DATA>` -- are never
# pruned, because they do not appear in every build and one run seeing none of them
# does not mean they are gone. To retire one of those, allowlist it instead; we are
# never going to fix a warning in Apple's headers.
#
# --update-baseline without --prune-baseline adds to this file rather than replacing
# it, so it can absorb a batch of new pre-existing debt (a toolchain upgrade, say)
# without dropping anything.
